Server Waypoint icons that name a game item now appear on VoxelMap's maps on 1.20.1
Fabric. Before this change only the packaged `voxelmap:<suffix>` images crossed into
VoxelMap; an item icon such as `minecraft:diamond_sword` synced with the empty image
suffix and displayed VoxelMap's ordinary waypoint image on both the minimap and the
full map.

VoxelMap stores a waypoint icon as an image suffix resolved against its own texture
atlas, so an item icon cannot travel through `Waypoint.imageSuffix`. This mod therefore
keeps the resolved `ItemStack` beside each synced waypoint and draws it itself:
`VoxelMapItemIcons` maps a `Waypoint` to its item icon with weak keys, filled by
`VoxelMapWaypointHelper.toVoxelMapWaypoint` through the existing
`WaypointIconRenderer.resolve` resolver and dropped by `removeSyncedWaypoints`.

Two mixins replace VoxelMap's atlas marker with that item:

- `VoxelMapMapIconMixin` cancels `Map#drawWaypoint` for a waypoint that has an item icon
  and draws the icon itself, so VoxelMap's marker is replaced rather than overlaid.
  `VoxelMapMarkerOffset` holds the placement maths copied from `Map#drawWaypoint`
  (rotation, zoom and the square/circular edge clamping), which keeps the icon where
  VoxelMap's own marker would have been and makes the geometry testable without a game.
- `VoxelMapGuiPersistentMapMixin` redirects the atlas blit inside
  `GuiPersistentMap#drawWaypoint` and draws the item instead; the surrounding name,
  hover and highlight handling of that method is untouched, and icons are counter-rotated
  upright when the old-north option rotates the map.

`VoxelMapItemIconRenderer` draws the item with the vanilla GUI item renderer on both
surfaces, clearing the waypoint colour VoxelMap sets as the shader colour, restoring it
afterwards, and reusing `WaypointItemAlpha` so disabled markers fade like VoxelMap's own
markers. Minimap icons cover 12 GUI pixels against VoxelMap's 8 pixel marker box,
because item textures keep transparent padding.

## Gating

Both the new mixin's injector and the renderer are inside `//? if <= 1.20.1` blocks,
so the 1.20.1-pinned VoxelMap build is the only target that receives them; other

+# VoxelMap item icons — 2026-10-25
+
+Server Waypoint icons that name a game item now appear on VoxelMap's maps on 1.20.1
+Fabric. Before this change only the packaged `voxelmap:<suffix>` images crossed into
+VoxelMap; an item icon such as `minecraft:diamond_sword` synced with the empty image
+suffix and displayed VoxelMap's ordinary waypoint image on both the minimap and the
+full map.
+
+VoxelMap stores a waypoint icon as an image suffix resolved against its own texture
+atlas, so an item icon cannot travel through `Waypoint.imageSuffix`. This mod therefore
+keeps the resolved `ItemStack` beside each synced waypoint and draws it itself:
+`VoxelMapItemIcons` maps a `Waypoint` to its item icon with weak keys, filled by
+`VoxelMapWaypointHelper.toVoxelMapWaypoint` through the existing
+`WaypointIconRenderer.resolve` resolver and dropped by `removeSyncedWaypoints`.
+
+Two mixins replace VoxelMap's atlas marker with that item:
+
+- `VoxelMapMapIconMixin` cancels `Map#drawWaypoint` for a waypoint that has an item icon
+  and draws the icon itself, so VoxelMap's marker is replaced rather than overlaid.
+  `VoxelMapMarkerOffset` holds the placement maths copied from `Map#drawWaypoint`
+  (rotation, zoom and the square/circular edge clamping), which keeps the icon where
+  VoxelMap's own marker would have been and makes the geometry testable without a game.
+- `VoxelMapGuiPersistentMapMixin` redirects the atlas blit inside
+  `GuiPersistentMap#drawWaypoint` and draws the item instead; the surrounding name,
+  hover and highlight handling of that method is untouched, and icons are counter-rotated
+  upright when the old-north option rotates the map.
+
+`VoxelMapItemIconRenderer` draws the item with the vanilla GUI item renderer on both
+surfaces, clearing the waypoint colour VoxelMap sets as the shader colour, restoring it
+afterwards, and reusing `WaypointItemAlpha` so disabled markers fade like VoxelMap's own
+markers. Minimap icons cover 12 GUI pixels against VoxelMap's 8 pixel marker box,
+because item textures keep transparent padding.
+
+## Gating
+
+Both the new mixin's injector and the renderer are inside `//? if <= 1.20.1` blocks,
+so the 1.20.1-pinned VoxelMap build is the only target that receives them; other
+voxelmap-pinned targets compile the same files as empty classes and keep the previous
+default-image behaviour.
+
